results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. A routine penalty or notice that is not material under POL-MAT-01 is a limitation, not an adverse event. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Breakout strategy entry and exit
results.text: BREAKOUT enters on a ready row when Close exceeds the shifted prior 20-session high and ADX14 is at least 18. Its signal exit is Close below EMA20. The current high is not included in Prior20High, preventing a same-session high from entering its own comparison window. Breakout uses separately configured risk (default 0.5% equity), initial stop 2.5 ATR, trailing 2.5 entry ATR activated after 1R close gain. Stop fills first. One later confirmed re-entry per setup is allowed within ten trading sessions: close above stopped level, EMA20 and previous high; ADX>=18; no high-vol or warmup. Fresh C2 and the same strict recent source quote and independent critic are mandatory. Fill at a later eligible open. No same-candle rebuy or averaging down. A second stop exhausts the setup; profit/adverse exits do not create rebound watches. The approved catalogue includes EMA_PULLBACK for PULLBACK: ADX14>=22, EMA20>EMA50, an EMA20 touch holding EMA50 in a prior three-session window, followed by a completed close above EMA20 and prior-session high. Exit on EMA20<EMA50, or code protective/profit/C2 exits. Routing gives this confirmed pullback priority over breakout. BREAKOUT_BOUNCE is portfolio-owned stop/rebound context and routes only to BREAKOUT.

results.title: RSI reversion entry threshold
results.text: The implemented RSI_REVERSION entry requires a ready row, RSI14 below 42 and Close above 0.88 times EMA50. This is the current code specification. RSI below 30 with an upward confirmation appeared only as a proposal example and is not the implemented entry rule.

results.title: Trend regime classification
results.text: TREND requires ADX14 at least 22 and EMA20 above EMA50, after higher-priority warm-up, high-volatility and breakout checks. Code permits EMA_TREND for this regime. A permitted route is distinct from an entry signal and does not guarantee an executable or profitable order.

results.title: EMA trend entry
results.text: EMA_TREND enters only on a ready row with EMA20 above EMA50 and Close above EMA20. Both moving averages and the closing price are numerical code evidence, not LLM estimates. A signal from a completed close is only eligible for a later-session historical fill.

Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. A routine penalty or notice that is not material under POL-MAT-01 is a limitation, not an adverse event. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Historical issuer library, financial OCR and temporal coverage
results.text: A reusable official NSE catalogue records successful historical announcement windows and original publication/dissemination timestamps for the configured universes. Company tools may reuse a checksum-verified catalogue only when successful windows fully cover the requested date range; otherwise public archive retrieval is required. Metadata is filtered to the requested interval, and the existing 15:30 IST company cutoff still excludes future and after-close disclosures. Invalid timestamps and failed/truncated responses remain explicit gaps. Downloaded quarterly results, annual reports and issuer releases are separate from the policy-search corpus and are projected only into the selected company/date pack, preventing a timeless vector store from mixing future financial evidence into old cases. Local machine OCR may recover image-based tables from the original PDF with its raw and text hashes retained, but OCR does not independently verify numerical accuracy, units, reporting period or table-column alignment. Do not invent a precise metric or treat an ambiguous OCR cell as a fact. Cite only observed source-supported claims and disclose extraction limitations. A readable document, successful download or broad catalogue is not a clean-company finding or proof of complete independent-news/newsletter coverage. Existing adverse scan caps, independent critic, exact breakout quote checks and source/date gates remain unchanged. Earlier source snapshots and saved trading results are retained; refreshed company pack hashes require fresh research/approval.

results.title: Raw-price discontinuities and known structural-action quarantine
results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. It cannot repair the economic value of an already-held position affected by a split, bonus or demerger. In addition, a readable non-financial disclosure explicitly titled as a demerger, stock/share split, bonus issue, rights issue or capital reduction and available within the preceding 30 calendar days quarantines new entries on the unadjusted simulator. Use full source metadata before display-title truncation. The reason is price comparability and missing entitlement accounting, not adverse news. Do not use the action itself as positive breakout corroboration or force a holding sale merely because of that label. This bounded disclosure check is not a complete corporate-action calendar and does not repair existing holdings or distributions. Do not treat a raw ex-action stop loss as complete shareholder economic P&L when distributed shares/cash entitlements are unaccounted.

results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. A routine penalty or notice that is not material under POL-MAT-01 is a limitation, not an adverse event. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Breakout strategy entry and exit
results.text: BREAKOUT enters on a ready row when Close exceeds the shifted prior 20-session high and ADX14 is at least 18. Its signal exit is Close below EMA20. The current high is not included in Prior20High, preventing a same-session high from entering its own comparison window. Breakout uses separately configured risk (default 0.5% equity), initial stop 2.5 ATR, trailing 2.5 entry ATR activated after 1R close gain. Stop fills first. One later confirmed re-entry per setup is allowed within ten trading sessions: close above stopped level, EMA20 and previous high; ADX>=18; no high-vol or warmup. Fresh C2 and the same strict recent source quote and independent critic are mandatory. Fill at a later eligible open. No same-candle rebuy or averaging down. A second stop exhausts the setup; profit/adverse exits do not create rebound watches. The approved catalogue includes EMA_PULLBACK for PULLBACK: ADX14>=22, EMA20>EMA50, an EMA20 touch holding EMA50 in a prior three-session window, followed by a completed close above EMA20 and prior-session high. Exit on EMA20<EMA50, or code protective/profit/C2 exits. Routing gives this confirmed pullback priority over breakout. BREAKOUT_BOUNCE is portfolio-owned stop/rebound context and routes only to BREAKOUT.

results.title: C1 evidence-first portfolio flow
results.text: Strategy Backtests offers C2 specialist research, C1 single-agent SMC and technical-only replay. C1 first applies history/liquidity/volatility/discontinuity constraints, rotates through at most three liquid unheld candidates per session, and researches dated company sources before inspecting SMC eligibility. The COMPANY_SCREEN agent sees no SMC context or routed signal; return strategy NONE and action SCREEN. RAG policy plus company_evidence MCP are mandatory; bounded dated web fallback can supplement missing/unknown sources. Verified dated newsletters are supplementary, not substitutes for a failed official scan or invented financial filings. A passing company screen is not a trade approval: only later code-confirmed SMC can queue a buy. Missing/unknown or adverse evidence blocks; no coverage-only strong-trend exemption applies. C1 has no independent model critic; typed/source/risk validation still applies. The same frozen dated screen and causal SMC proof are revalidated before fill. Eight inference units are reserved per bounded case, while actual calls may be fewer. Checkpoint, pause, resume, progress and provider failure handling are shared with C2, but saved flow cannot switch.

results.title: Raw-price discontinuities and known structural-action quarantine
results.text: Daily stock screening excludes new candidates for twenty sessions after a raw close-to-close jump above thirty percent. This is a quarantine, not corporate-action adjustment. It cannot repair the economic value of an already-held position affected by a split, bonus or demerger. In addition, a readable non-financial disclosure explicitly titled as a demerger, stock/share split, bonus issue, rights issue or capital reduction and available within the preceding 30 calendar days quarantines new entries on the unadjusted simulator. Use full source metadata before display-title truncation. The reason is price comparability and missing entitlement accounting, not adverse news. Do not use the action itself as positive breakout corroboration or force a holding sale merely because of that label. results.title: Strategy-specific evidence, coverage gaps and adverse-news exits
results.text: C2 always checks dated evidence before a permitted action. For a code-qualified strong EMA_TREND or confirmed EMA_PULLBACK entry (ADX at least 22, Close above EMA20 above EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI below 42, Close above 0.88 EMA50), missing financial or independent news coverage alone is not an entry veto. Inspect company evidence and attempt bounded dated web retrieval when coverage is missing or unknown. With no identified concrete unresolved adverse event, a LIMITED assessment may use COVERAGE_LIMITED, an observed attempted WEBSCAN or ready official SCAN citation, empty event_risks and explicit coverage limitations. This permits following the technical signal with residual evidence risk; it never establishes clean fundamentals, safety or profit. Concrete potentially serious unresolved event risk remains UNKNOWN and blocks entry; it cannot be hidden as a mere coverage gap. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding can use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT (including BREAKOUT_BOUNCE) entry requires readable dated corroborating company evidence, exact document citations, breakout_support explaining the source-backed support, and a supported adverse assessment. COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Actual cited adverse news uses REVIEW_REQUIRED with ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE and nonempty supported event_risks. Both adverse categories block entry; in a holding review they require EXIT after independent critic verification. A genuine adverse event, not a negative keyword, is necessary. A routine penalty or notice that is not material under POL-MAT-01 is a limitation, not an adverse event. Routine trading-window closure for insiders is not business closure or proof of insider wrongdoing. Interpret substantive disclosure_context and exact source windows; do not treat address fragments as monetary exposure. Attribute issuer-reported Nil and preserve missing impact as unknown. Market and critic independently read the current hashed company pack and observed policy evidence. Daily bounded official issuer metadata checks can trigger holding research between scheduled reviews; empty checks make no generation call. Publication and availability must be at or before the historical cutoff; after-close releases are first considered at a later eligible close. A confirmed exit queues a later-open simulated sale, with existing gap/stop/profit protections; no same-close look-ahead and no forced end-period liquidation. Stops, fees, position sizing, Friday/gap refresh, human approval where required and execution remain code controlled. Search failures and truncated sources are recorded; a live dated web lookup is not a certified historical content archive or exhaustive news feed. Lessons cannot override this policy or the independent critic. Breakout corroboration must be structured as document_id, kind, exact contiguous visible quote and relevance, with source availability no more than 30 calendar days before the signal cutoff. Code checks a reported benefit metric and an earnings/operating improvement or completed commercial event; prose alone, an auditor review, vague business focus, provider selection or a prospective forecast is insufficient. Sole support consisting of plans, expected/indicated gains or up-to targets is not an achieved result. The independent critic must separately quote and corroborate the same source; accept=true alone is insufficient. A structurally valid source and critic approval still do not predict price direction. Known recent explicit structural-action disclosures also invoke the raw-price entry quarantine in POL-60. Reject unsupported quotes rather than invent missing evidence; later profit or loss must never select a historical entry.

results.title: Historical issuer library, financial OCR and temporal coverage
results.text: A reusable official NSE catalogue records successful historical announcement windows and original publication/dissemination timestamps for the configured universes. Company tools may reuse a checksum-verified catalogue only when successful windows fully cover the requested date range; otherwise public archive retrieval is required. Metadata is filtered to the requested interval, and the existing 15:30 IST company cutoff still excludes future and after-close disclosures. Invalid timestamps and failed/truncated responses remain explicit gaps. Downloaded quarterly results, annual reports and issuer releases are separate from the policy-search corpus and are projected only into the selected company/date pack, preventing a timeless vector store from mixing future financial evidence into old cases. Local machine OCR may recover image-based tables from the original PDF with its raw and text hashes retained, but OCR does not independently verify numerical accuracy, units, reporting period or table-column alignment. Do not invent a precise metric or treat an ambiguous OCR cell as a fact. Cite only observed source-supported claims and disclose extraction limitations. A readable document, successful download or broad catalogue is not a clean-company finding or proof of complete independent-news/newsletter coverage. Existing adverse scan caps, independent critic, exact breakout quote checks and source/date gates remain unchanged. Earlier source snapshots and saved trading results are retained; refreshed company pack hashes require fresh research/approval.

results.title: Materiality of routine penalties and regulatory notices
results.text: A monetary penalty, fine, tax or duty demand, late fee or similar routine regulatory notice is an adverse event only when the cited sources show at least one of the following: the amount is significant relative to the issuer's reported profit, revenue or net worth in the cited financial filing; it restricts operations, licences, management, listing or the ability to do business; it alleges fraud or misconduct; or the issuer itself reports a material impact. The comparison uses the issuer's own reported figures, never a fixed rupee threshold. A notice that meets none of these conditions is recorded in limitations with its document cited, leaves event_risks empty, permits NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND when the adverse-disclosure scan is ready, does not block an entry and does not force an exit in a holding review. If the amount or its scale cannot be read, the event risk is UNKNOWN and blocks entry. Reason: large issuers disclose small penalties almost every month under Regulation 30; treating each one as adverse made C2 refuse every entry in such stocks, which is abstention by rule and not evidence review. This rule changes classification only; it never changes sizing, stops or other code-owned risk limits.

results.title: Daily-bar SMC strategy definition
results.text: SMC is a code-defined daily-bar price-action approximation, not proof of institutional activity. Regular first entries require a low below the prior 20 completed lows with close back above that level; within ten bars a later bullish displacement close exceeds the five-bar pre-sweep high with body at least 0.5 ATR; the last preceding bearish candle defines an order block from its low to open. Within ten further bars a later candle overlaps the zone and closes bullish above its upper bound. A close below its low invalidates the setup. No same-sweep/BOS-bar entry, future-confirmed pivots or required FVG. A qualifying close fills at a later eligible open only after evidence and code/risk checks. Normal exits use a configurable net profit target (C1 default 4%), protective stops, optionally enabled trailing, and cited adverse C1 EXIT. No EMA/RSI signal exit or forced terminal sale applies to SMC. These prototype parameters are not optimized or proven profitable. A stopped-position recovery is a separate code-owned variant under POL-75; it never substitutes price recovery for fresh company evidence.

results.title: C1 evidence-first portfolio flow
results.text: Strategy Backtests offers C2 specialist research, C1 single-agent SMC and technical-only replay. C1 first applies history/liquidity/volatility/discontinuity constraints, rotates through at most three liquid unheld candidates per session, and researches dated company sources before inspecting SMC eligibility. The COMPANY_SCREEN agent sees no SMC context or routed signal; return strategy NONE and action SCREEN. RAG policy plus company_evidence MCP are mandatory; bounded dated web fallback can supplement missing/unknown sources. Verified dated newsletters are supplementary, not substitutes for a failed official scan or invented financial filings. A passing company screen is not a trade approval: only later code-confirmed SMC can queue a buy. Missing/unknown or adverse evidence blocks; no coverage-only strong-trend exemption applies. C1 has no independent model critic; typed/source/risk validation still applies. The same frozen dated screen and causal SMC proof are revalidated before fill. Eight inference units are reserved per bounded case, while actual calls may be fewer. Checkpoint, pause, resume, progress and provider failure handling are shared with C2, but saved flow cannot switch.
